apps.name: Bluebox
apps.subtitle: Movies and TV, your sources
apps.localizedDescription: A Netflix-style player for your own sources: Stremio add-ons, torrents, debrid, Jellyfin and your files. Personal builds.

versions.localizedDescription:
Subtitles
• Subtitle Style opens as a panel beside the video, and the picture moves over to make room, so every change shows on the real video.
• New presets: Standard, Cinema, Boxed, Bold Outline and Large Print.
• Choose the font in the player, from a list that shows each font in itself.
• Position: drag the subtitles on a small picture (or on the video) and they snap to Top, Middle or Bottom.
• While the controls show, subtitles move up just far enough to clear them, the video's own tracks included, and never jump.
• Settings › Subtitles uses the same presets, fonts and position picture as the player.

Player
• An equaliser in Tools › Sound: ten bands you drag, presets (Voice, Bass Boost, Treble, Cinema, Music, Headphones), and Preamp.
• Night Mode works with VLC (MKV and most torrents).
• Picture has Frame and Colour tabs.
• On the Mac the switches in the player's cards are switches, not checkboxes.

Everything that changed: https://github.com/BCYAYAY14/bluebox/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

Subtitles
• Bluebox now draws plain subtitle tracks inside MKV and WebM files itself, instead of VLC.
• Subtitle files that come with a torrent are listed under their language, tagged Torrent.
• Subtitles show in Picture in Picture and on AirPlay, in your own style.
• A Lines page beside Style and Timing lists every line with its time.
• Sync to the Audio, at the top of Timing, listens to the speech and lines the subtitles up for you, on your device.
• Hide Sound Cues, on the Subtitle Style page, leaves out [siren wailing], ♪ lyrics and speaker names.
• Search Online looks on OpenSubtitles, Subdl, Podnapisi and your Jellyfin server at once, best match first.
• Fixed a dark copy of the first letters showing behind VLC's subtitles.

Player
• Skip Intro and Skip Recap show on their own for 8 seconds, then only while the controls are up.
• On the Mac, a click on the video plays or pauses.
• New keys: ⇧← and ⇧→ go to the previous or next subtitle line, C turns subtitles off and back on (crop moves to ⇧C), 0–9 jump to 0–90%, and < > step a frame.
• Fixed playback sticking on "Buffering" after stepping frame by frame, even with the whole file downloaded.

Updates (Mac)
• Checking for, downloading and installing an update happens in place in Settings › About, with no popups.
• The updater installs only a Bluebox signed with Bluebox's release certificate, checks the download against GitHub's checksum, and puts the old version back if the new one fails its check.

Security
• Sign-in links no longer sign you in.
• Signing in to a different account asks what happens to this device's library before anything moves.
• API keys sync between devices only with Sync API Keys on (Settings › Account), which is off by default.
• Links of add-ons you added by link, which often hold a debrid key, are kept in the Keychain, not in preferences or settings sync.
• Remote control uses private channels only your account can join.
• A connect link opened from outside asks before pointing Bluebox at its server.
• Very large numbers from an add-on can no longer crash the app.
• SECURITY.md says how to report a vulnerability privately.

Everything that changed: https://github.com/BCYAYAY14/bluebox/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

Mac
• Installing from the DMG: a new window, Bluebox's black and blue with an arrow from the app to Applications, the version, and what to do if macOS won't open Bluebox the first time.

Episodes
• A watched episode shows a full blue bar under its picture, the same as one you've started, instead of a WATCHED tag.

Fixed
• Updating from inside the Mac app failed with "hdiutil: attach failed - Operation not permitted".
• After an update installed, the old Bluebox never quit, so the new one never opened.

Everything that changed: https://github.com/BCYAYAY14/bluebox/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

Player
• Picking a subtitle track or changing how subtitles look never reopens the video, so there's no rebuffer.
• Picking a subtitle no longer switches the audio to the file's default track.
• Opening the subtitle card no longer stutters: the track list isn't rebuilt several times a second, and ASS subtitles no longer load about 140 MB of Chinese, Japanese and Korean fonts each time they start.
• A simpler Subtitle Style card: presets, then Size, Colour, Background, Outline and Position.
• Every subtitle language is in one list that scrolls inside the card.
• Tools is three columns on a phone.
• Subtitles from files and subtitles in the video use the same font.
• Infuse as an external player: Open in Infuse on each release and finished download, and Settings › Player › Always Open in Infuse (this device only).

Downloads
• A show's page has one ↓ button beside the season, with a menu: Download Season, Unwatched Only, As One Season Pack, and Download Rules….
• Download Rules has no Use Defaults / Custom switch.

Fixed
• Torrents that reached "ready" but wouldn't play after the app had been in the background.
• Titles saved while using one catalog (TMDB or Cinemeta) still open, with their progress, downloads and My List, after switching to the other.
• A changelog, on the front page of the public repository.

Everything that changed: https://github.com/BCYAYAY14/bluebox/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

Player
• Subtitles are listed by language.
• A new subtitle Style page, with a live sample, Look and Position tabs, a nine-spot anchor, Apply Now, and one note on what applies to the current track.
• Subtitle timing, audio delay and speed share one dial: the value in words, steps you can hold down, and a slider.
• Denser cards on a phone turned on its side.

Fixed
• ASS subtitle tracks show again when the video carries no fonts of its own.
• Closing the player never leaves sound playing: not while a video is still opening, not after the red button, not after a second Play, and not after Cancel.
• The credits countdown waits while the video is paused or a card is open.
• Holding for 2× speed no longer sticks.
• Speed carries over between episodes.
• Esc closes an open card before it leaves full screen.
• The episode list retries when it fails to load.
• Subtitle timing starts fresh for each file.
• The second line of a two-line subtitle stays on screen.
• Downloaded subtitles no longer overwrite each other.
• Five subtitle files that failed to parse now load.
• The buffering spinner waits a moment before it shows, and never covers a card.

Everything that changed: https://github.com/BCYAYAY14/bluebox/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

• Every secret is kept in one Keychain item, so a Mac asks for Keychain access once instead of once per secret.
• Mac builds are signed with a stable certificate, so Always Allow lasts across updates.
• Mac updates: the app downloads the update itself, with progress over the window and in Settings › About, and gives up after 30 seconds without data.
• A subtitle change that reopens the stream keeps the audio track that was playing.

Everything that changed: https://github.com/BCYAYAY14/bluebox/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

• Mac player: changing subtitle size no longer reopens the stream, and never crashes.
• Mac player: fixed a crash when switching videos (seen with AV1).

Everything that changed: https://github.com/BCYAYAY14/bluebox/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

The first release from the open-source repository, under the MIT licence.

Highlights
• Home: Top Picks, Because You Watched, Continue Watching that goes on to the next episode, and Not Interested.
• Profiles: Kids profiles and maturity limits, PIN lock, per-profile settings, and a Profiles menu on the Mac.
• Lists: a Library grid, list pages, Add to List, smart lists and Play All, synced between devices.
• Search: stable sections, filter chips, recent searches with pictures, and instant results from the cache and your library.
• Release picker: quality groups, chips and tags, with duplicates folded together.
• Downloads: whole seasons and season packs, a queue screen, show pages, and Download Rules.
• Smart Downloads: per-show rules, caps, a download window, upgrades, subtitles, and deleting watched episodes while keeping the next ones ready on Wi-Fi.
• Player: Audio & Subtitles picker with clean track names, an episodes panel, styled subtitles, torrent availability on the timeline, and anchored cards for tracks, speed and tools.
• Sync: API keys, add-ons, settings and lists sync through your own Supabase project, live.
• Live Activity for downloads on iPhone, a downloads item in the Mac menu bar, and iPhone as a remote for the Mac player.
• My Bluebox: watch statistics, a spoiler guard, always-skip per show, and release alerts.
• Updates: checks GitHub's latest release once a day and from Settings › About.
• Settings › Storage: Clear Search History and Erase All Data.
• A custom About window on the Mac.

Fixed
• Torrent downloads keep running in the background on iPhone and iPad.
• Home retries dropped requests and keeps the lists that did load.
• Searches no longer get stuck.
• The Mac app always opens with its main window, and Window › Bluebox (⌘0) brings it back.
• The Mac app no longer hangs at launch (the menu-bar downloads item rebuilt the window in a loop), and a Keychain prompt can no longer freeze it before the window appears.
• The player no longer hangs when stretching video.
• The Dynamic Island stays hidden while the player is up.

Everything that changed: https://github.com/BCYAYAY14/bluebox/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Bluebox connects to media servers on your local network that you add in Settings.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Bluebox saves video frames you capture with Snapshot to your photo library.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Bluebox listens to the film's soundtrack on this device to line subtitles up with the speech (Sync to the Audio).
